role: Upstream public-interface correctness remediation before selected-first prior-tail inference
defect: J8A encoded first-public vacuum as not(flux or charge), contradicting the frozen J6O independent-membership rule vacuum=1-charge. J8B copied those first records into its complete-law result. The two fluxful sites therefore had invalid vacuum bits in every affected first record.
question: Can the complete J8A/J8B matrix be restored to the frozen public interface without changing exact first masses, conditional second laws, or downstream geometry and coverage results?

competing_outcomes.representation_only: All affected first records normalize to the frozen public representation; first masses, all 96 second laws, zero-mass exclusions and downstream consumed fields replay exactly.
competing_outcomes.numerical_change: Any corrected public first record changes an exact probability, law, action binding or downstream consumed field; withhold J8A/J8B and dependent J8J coverage until a new physical-law contract is registered.

frozen_model: Same ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit, 36 red-edge private IID X channel, 13 J8A private errors, four first charge records, two fixed relation-free actions, and exact-rational projector laws. Preserve all original scientific inputs, code, rates and caps; correct only the public first-record vacuum bit on fluxful unmeasured sites according to J6O public_record. No stochastic history, new physical law, schedule, risk or threshold is introduced.

branches: Regenerate and verify all 52 J8A first-record/mass cells through its pinned runner, then replace only the first public vacuum projection.

Regenerate and verify all 104 J8B error/first/action cells through its pinned runner, normalize the embedded first records, and replay every positive complete second law under the unchanged action and public interface.
Audit the J8C field-level consumer and the J8J known-support union so the correction does not silently invalidate dependent geometry or prior-coverage evidence.
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin all original inputs/sources and the remediation runner before/after. Require every corrected public first record equals J6O public_record(flux,charge); base all-plus equals J7M; count 52 corrected J8A and 52 embedded J8B first records, 96 normalized positive second laws, eight zero-mass action exclusions, 26 J7Z all-plus replays, unchanged exact masses, conditional law rows, TV results, actions and the only two J8C consumed J8B fields. Require corrected J8B plus J8I to cover exactly 67 same-flux errors. Preserve originals as invalid public-record provenance.
matrix.independent_unit: One deterministic error/first-record/action exact cell; no stochastic independent unit or interval.

acceptance: All 52 J8A and 52 J8B embedded first records satisfy the frozen full-binary public interface and base selected record replays J7M
All numeric first masses, 96 second laws, eight exclusions, all actions, 26 all-plus replays and exact TVs are unchanged
J8C consumed-field and J8J 67-support downstream boundaries checked
Original J8A/J8B public-record payloads are explicitly withheld; no full-prior information, risk, noisy-JIT, L=3 or threshold inference
stop_rule: Fail closed at the first pin, replay, public-record, law, downstream-field or CPU mismatch. Do not mutate original J8A/J8B artifacts or silently rerun J8C-I; require a separately registered transition if any numerical field changes.
